web.title: Changes to social security payments from March 20
web.description:
# Changes to social security payments from March 20
The lower deeming rate will be updated to 1.25% for financial assets under $64,200 for singles and $106,200 for couples combined, and the upper rate will be 3.25% for financial assets over these amounts.

web.title: Age Pension 2026: New Rates & Deeming Changes | Great Advice
web.description:
## The deeming freeze has ended. What does that do to my pension?
The lower deeming rate is now 1.25% and the upper rate is now 3.25%, and the increase reduces Age Pension entitlements for some people with significant financial assets outside the family home, because deemed income is now higher.

The deeming rates themselves are unchanged since 20 March 2026, at 1.25% lower and 3.25% upper.

The lower rate is now 1.25% and the upper rate is now 3.25%.

The lower rate moved from 0.25% to 1.25% and the upper rate moved from 2.25% to 3.25%.

**1.25%**

The first $66,800 is deemed at 1.25% and the balance at 3.25%.
